Calculate the discriminant (b² - 4ac). If it’s positive, two real solutions; if zero, one solution; if negative, complex solutions. Plug in the numbers and simplify. Differentiate the function f(x) to get f'(x). Set f'(x) = 0 and solve for x. These x-values are the candidates for stationary points. Plug them back into f(x) to find the y-values.
